text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: routing.latency.p99(us-west) = 1280ms (> SLO 900ms). error_rate ~4% and rising. PagerDuty: escalation triggered -> page fired.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to rotation 'eng-oncall' — incident key: pd_ABC123. Ack required.
maya: Acked. I'm taking first triage.
jordan: @maya I'm available to help if you need infra actions.
maya: quick check: dashboard shows request queue depth spiking on tokenizer service v2. Recent deploy ~10m ago?
samir: saw that deploy, rolling back now.
maya: ops run: kubectl -n prod set image deploy/tokenizer tokenizer=image:v2.1->image:v2.0 ; monitoring.
ops-bot: Rollout started: tokenizer -> v2.0 (replicas scaling 3->6). See: https://k8s/rollouts/xyz
laura: warming KV cache on edge nodes to reduce cold-starts. running: for region in us-west; do curl -s https://warm/kv?key=prefix & done
maya: latency dropping to ~920ms p99 after first pod updated. still above SLO but trending down.
jordan: good — can we enable immediate routing fallback to eu if p99 > 1.2s? I can flip route.
maya: please, do it.
jordan: flipped traffic: us-west -> 80%, eu ->20% for inference-route. command: rdctl routing set --route inference --split us-west=80,eu=20
ops-bot: Routing update accepted. New split propagated to edge nodes.
maya: PagerDuty: acknowledged, leaving note: initial regression likely v2 model change + cold cache. rollback + routing performed. continuing to monitor.
samir: rollback finished, all pods on v2.0. p99 now ~760ms.
maya: closing PD incident if stable for 5m. next 10m watch.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by maya. Incident: pd_ABC123. Status: acknowledged.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup: 
laura: FYI I'll open a postmortem ticket with traces and rollout diff.
maya: copying logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:11Z] tokenizer v2.1 warmup=0 p99=1345ms
[2026-03-12T14:05:40Z] rollout started -> v2.0
[2026-03-12T14:07:10Z] p99 -> 770ms
```
maya: ending thread. :white_check_mark:
